subject: Temporary analytics relay joining vendor roster — review & export-control checkpoints
messages:
From: Amit (Spinlytics) <support@spinlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary analytics relay onboarding — short notice

Hi Irene,

Quick heads up — we need to add a short-lived analytics relay (SpinRelay) to our vendor roster to support a one-week ingest for a pilot EU customer. It will only buffer telemetry (non-identifying metrics) and forward to Spinlytics' EU cluster.

I attached a delta export of the proposed roster change (vendor_roster_delta_20261111.csv). From our end:
- Purpose: pilot telemetry buffering for A/B experiment (no raw user content)
- Residency: EU-only (Ireland & Frankfurt)
- Retention: ephemeral (48 hours)
- Access controls: read-only service account, audit logs enabled

Can you confirm whether this needs a DPA addendum or an export-control review? We want to keep the window tight (target start 2026-11-18).

Thanks,
Amit
Spinlytics — Partnerships

[attachment: vendor_roster_delta_20261111.csv (text/csv)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Amit (Spinlytics) <support@spinlytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary analytics relay onboarding — short notice

Amit — thanks for the context and the delta.

Quick internal note: Copying Kimberly (privacy/legal intake) and Karthik (procurement/infra) — request is EU-only and retention sounds constrained which helps, but we still need:
1) A short DPA addendum that explicitly lists SpinRelay and scope (telemetry only).
2) Export-control checklist: confirm no PII or identifiers transit. The telemetry schema you send should include example payloads.
3) Ops contact and access grant TTL.

Marissa — can you slot an evidence pass on this? If it’s purely metrics (no user identifiers) we can treat as low-risk but must get a signed addendum before the start date.

Amit — if you can share the telemetry schema and the ops on-call, we’ll fast-track.

Best,
Irene Choi
Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary analytics relay onboarding — short notice

Irene / Kimberly — I reviewed the roster delta and ran the quick evidence checklist. Summary:
- SpinRelay appears to be an ephemeral relay service we already have a lightweight attestation for (dated 2025) but not explicitly named.
- Impact: low for processing scope (metrics-only) but we need the addendum and a retention guarantee in writing.
- Actionables (my picks):
  * Draft DPA addendum listing SpinRelay, scope = telemetry, retention = 48h, residency = EU. (I started a draft and attached as dpa_amendment_draft_20261112.docx.)
  * Export-control: request a sample payload CSV and confirmation no hashed identifiers are present.
  * Ops: require a service account TTL and proof that KV caches are not storing user-level keys.

Kimberly — can legal review the attached DPA redline and confirm signatures? If legal prefers, loop in Olivia Grant (Quantum Legal) for a 1-hour review.

Marissa
Product Ops / Vendor Compliance
Redwood Inference

[attachment: dpa_amendment_draft_20261112.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit (Spinlytics) <support@spinlytics.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia@quantum-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary analytics relay onboarding — short notice

Thanks everyone — quick decision path here so Spinlytics can start on schedule: 

To Amit / Spinlytics: please confirm the two items below by end of day tomorrow (2026-11-14 23:59 UTC):
1) Example telemetry payloads (CSV) showing field names and a note confirming no persistent identifiers or user IDs are present.
2) Ops contact and service account TTL (must be <= 7 days) and details about log retention on your side; we need a statement that logs related to this relay will be purged within 72 hours and that access is auditable.

Conditional approvals from Redwood: if both items are delivered and Marissa's DPA addendum draft is signed, we will allow SpinRelay to be added to the temporary roster and begin EU-only routing. We will also require:
- An export_matrix_spinlytics.pdf be uploaded to the shared drive (for audit).
- DocuSign execution of the addendum before the first data flow.

Olivia — please review the attached DPA draft (Marissa) and flag any clauses that should be tightened for EU residency/export control; if you can return a brief redline by Monday 2026-11-16 that would be ideal.

Thanks — Irene, take the lead on intake and final signoff once we have artifacts.

Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy Intake & Contracts
Redwood Inference
